description: Who automerges. Tooling never ships in the artifact, so CI is the judge: every update type merges, majors included. Everything else (code the project ships: Go modules, crates, npm and PyPI dependencies, CDN links) automerges minors and patches; majors wait for me. Only `automerge` is set here, never a group or a schedule, so these rules can come before a hub's own groups without being overridden. A group only automerges when every member does; groups here are minor/patch (or ungrouped majors), so none mixes the two kinds (scripts/check-package-rules.mjs checks it for default.json).

packageRules.description: Tooling: GitHub Actions, mise tools, Copier template updates, pre-commit hooks. All update types, majors included.

Tooling read by custom managers rather than the ones above: the hk and hk-config pins (hugoh/hk-config//presets/hk-pins) and the biome $schema URL (customManagers:biomeVersions, and go-tools' template), which has to move with the mise pin. Without this the biome toolchain group would mix an automerging member with a manual one and never merge.
Everything else: minor and patch updates. Majors stay manual.
